The '''Imperial Badge of Merit''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who accomplished several important tasks.

One such badge was awarded to an Imperial-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] stationed at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] after carrying out several high-profile missions, including falsifying "evidence" to act as blackmail against the reigning Queen of Naboo to force her to give up a Rebel General under the orders of Emperor Palpatine, and completing inquiries for Darth Vader.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Badge of Merit appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It was awarded for completing the Imperial Themepark missions.
